blocks.zh: 一次性使用系統製造策略之考量要點
blocks.en: Points to Consider for Single-Use System Manufacturing Strategy

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Single-Use System (SUS) 製造策略的四大關鍵決策領域：技術、確認、商業驅動力、實施
blocks.en: Understand the four key decision areas of a Single-Use System (SUS) manufacturing strategy: technology, qualification, business drivers, and implementation

blocks.zh: 掌握 SUS 可行性評估的閘門式決策流程 (Gated Decision Pathway) 及其科學與風險導向方法
blocks.en: Master the gated decision pathway for assessing SUS feasibility and its science- and risk-based approach

blocks.zh: 學習如何從技術可行性、商業分析、產品/製程風險及物流控制等面向評估 SUS 導入方案
blocks.en: Learn how to evaluate an SUS adoption proposal from the perspectives of technical feasibility, business case, product/process risk, and logistics control

blocks.zh: 了解 SUS 實施過程中供應商管理、變更通知、廢棄物處理及供應鏈管理的重要考量
blocks.en: Understand the key considerations in SUS implementation: supplier management, change notification, waste handling, and supply chain management

blocks.zh: 本節目錄 Section Contents
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 3.0 Points to Consider for Single-Use System Manufacturing Strategy 3.0 一次性使用系統製造策略考量要點
blocks.en: 3.0 Points to Consider for Single-Use System Manufacturing Strategy

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Single-Use System, SUS (一次性使用系統): 由高分子材料組件組裝而成的工程化製程設備方案，設計為一次性或短期活動使用。與傳統 Multiple-Use System (MUS，多次使用系統) 相比，SUS 免除了 CIP/SIP 的需求，但引入了供應鏈依賴性和材料相容性等新挑戰。
blocks.en: Single-Use System, SUS: An engineered process equipment solution assembled from polymeric components and designed for single or short-term use. Compared with a Multiple-Use System (MUS), an SUS eliminates the need for CIP/SIP but introduces new challenges such as supply chain dependency and material compatibility.

blocks.zh: Manufacturing Strategy (製造策略): TR66 強調，成功導入 SUS 的關鍵不在於單一技術選擇，而是建立一套完整的製造策略。此策略必須涵蓋四大領域：
blocks.en: Manufacturing Strategy: TR66 stresses that successful SUS adoption does not hinge on a single technology choice but on building a complete manufacturing strategy. This strategy must cover four areas:

blocks.zh: Technologies (技術): SUS 能否滿足製程需求？
blocks.en: Technologies: Can the SUS meet the process requirements?

blocks.zh: Qualification (確認): 如何驗證組裝產品的品質？
blocks.en: Qualification: How is the quality of the assembled product verified?

blocks.zh: Business Drivers (商業驅動): 經濟效益是否合理？
blocks.en: Business Drivers: Is the economic case sound?

blocks.zh: Implementation (實施): 如何落地執行？
blocks.en: Implementation: How is it put into practice?

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你正在決定餐廳廚房要用免洗餐具還是瓷器餐具。免洗餐具 (SUS) 不需要洗碗機 (CIP) 和高壓消毒 (SIP)，換菜單更快 (快速換線)，但你必須確保：供應商能穩定供貨 (供應鏈)、材料不會溶出有害物質 (E&L)、用量和成本是否划算 (商業分析)、垃圾處理怎麼辦 (廢棄物管理)。這不是簡單的「買或不買」，而是一個需要全面評估的策略決策。
blocks.en: Imagine deciding whether a restaurant kitchen should use disposable tableware or porcelain. Disposables (SUS) need no dishwasher (CIP) or high-pressure sterilization (SIP), and changing the menu is faster (rapid changeover), but you must make sure of the following: the supplier can deliver reliably (supply chain), the material will not leach harmful substances (E&L), the volumes and costs make sense (business analysis), and you know what to do with the trash (waste management). This is not a simple "buy or don't buy" question but a strategic decision that needs a comprehensive assessment.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Gated Approach (閘門式決策): 這是 TR66 最核心的決策框架。每個「閘門」都是一個 Go/No-Go 決策點，採用科學與風險導向的方法。其設計理念是「快速失敗」(Fail Fast) — 如果在任何階段發現重大問題無法解決（例如影響病人安全），就應立即停止 SUS 導入。
blocks.en: Gated Approach: This is the core decision framework of TR66. Each "gate" is a Go/No-Go decision point, applying a science- and risk-based approach. The design philosophy is "fail fast": if a significant problem that cannot be resolved (for example, one affecting patient safety) is found at any stage, SUS adoption should be stopped immediately.

blocks.zh: Figure 3.0-2 所示的決策路徑包含六個關鍵閘門：
blocks.en: The decision pathway shown in Figure 3.0-2 contains six key gates:

blocks.zh: 技術可行性 (Technical Feasibility)
blocks.en: Technical Feasibility

blocks.zh: 商業可行性 (Business Case)
blocks.en: Business Case

blocks.zh: 產品風險 (Product Risk)
blocks.en: Product Risk

blocks.zh: 製程風險 (Process Risk)
blocks.en: Process Risk

blocks.zh: 製程控制策略 (Process Control Strategy)
blocks.en: Process Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 實施與物流策略 (Implementation & Logistics)
blocks.en: Implementation & Logistics

blocks.zh: 注意：此路徑不一定是線性的，終端使用者可以從任何一點進入，但每個階段都必須被妥善處理。
blocks.en: Note: this pathway is not necessarily linear. End users may enter at any point, but every stage must be properly addressed.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Figure Analysis
blocks.en: Figure Analysis

blocks.zh: Figure 3.0-2 (SUS 決策路徑): 此圖呈現一個串聯式的決策流程，每個方框代表一個評估領域，每個菱形代表一個決策閘門。只有當所有閘門都通過時，才能確認 SUS 是可行的。任何一個閘門的否定結果都可能導致「SUS may not be applicable」的結論。
blocks.en: Figure 3.0-2 (SUS decision pathway): This figure presents a serial decision flow in which each box represents an assessment area and each diamond represents a decision gate. SUS can be confirmed as viable only when all gates are passed. A negative outcome at any gate may lead to the conclusion that "SUS may not be applicable".

blocks.zh: Figure 3.0-3 (報告結構概覽): 此圖展示了 TR66 的三層架構：(1) 初步可行性研究 (Section 3)、(2) 四大驅動力的詳細討論 (Sections 4-7)、(3) 詳細實施工作流程 (Section 7)。這三層由上而下，從策略到執行。
blocks.en: Figure 3.0-3 (report structure overview): This figure shows the three-tier structure of TR66: (1) the initial feasibility study (Section 3), (2) detailed discussion of the four drivers (Sections 4-7), and (3) the detailed implementation workflow (Section 7). The three tiers run from top to bottom, from strategy to execution.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境: 作為 CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization)，你同時為多個客戶生產不同的生物製劑。導入 SUS 的最大價值在於縮短換線時間和降低交叉污染風險。但你必須評估：如果關鍵供應商斷貨，你能否在合理時間內切換到替代方案？這正是 TR66 閘門式決策框架的實際應用場景。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: As a CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization), you produce different biologics for multiple clients at the same time. The greatest value of adopting SUS lies in shorter changeover time and lower cross-contamination risk. But you must also ask: if a critical supplier runs out of stock, can you switch to an alternative within a reasonable time? This is exactly the practical setting for the TR66 gated decision framework.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR66 強調 SUS 製造策略必須採用「科學與風險導向」方法，而非僅靠經濟分析？
blocks.en: Why does TR66 stress that an SUS manufacturing strategy must take a "science- and risk-based" approach rather than rely on economic analysis alone?

blocks.zh: 在閘門式決策中，哪些情況下應該在第一個閘門就否決 SUS 方案？試舉三個例子。
blocks.en: In a gated decision, under what circumstances should an SUS proposal be rejected at the very first gate? Give three examples.

blocks.zh: 對於一家小型 CMO 而言，SUS 的哪些優勢最具吸引力？為什麼？
blocks.en: For a small CMO, which advantages of SUS are the most attractive, and why?

blocks.zh: 3.1 Single-Use Technologies 3.1 一次性使用技術
blocks.en: 3.1 Single-Use Technologies

blocks.zh: Technical Feasibility (技術可行性): 這是閘門式決策的第一道關卡。在考慮任何商業或實施因素之前，必須先確認 SUS 在技術上是否可行。評估重點包括：
blocks.en: Technical Feasibility: This is the first checkpoint in the gated decision. Before any business or implementation factor is considered, you must first confirm that SUS is technically feasible. The assessment focuses on:

blocks.zh: Materials of Construction (建構材料): SUS 主要使用高分子材料，必須與製程流體和產品相容
blocks.en: Materials of Construction: SUS mainly use polymeric materials, which must be compatible with the process fluid and the product

blocks.zh: Barrier Properties (阻隔特性): 高分子薄膜對氧氣、濕氣、光線的阻隔能力，直接影響產品穩定性
blocks.en: Barrier Properties: The ability of polymer films to block oxygen, moisture, and light directly affects product stability

blocks.zh: Operating Parameters (操作參數): SUS 在溫度、壓力、pH 等方面的耐受範圍通常比不鏽鋼系統窄
blocks.en: Operating Parameters: The tolerance range of SUS for temperature, pressure, pH, and so on is generally narrower than that of stainless steel systems

blocks.zh: 評估 SUS 技術可行性就像選擇廚房設備：你不會用塑膠鍋來做油炸（溫度限制），也不會用紙杯來裝酸性果汁長時間存放（化學相容性）。SUS 的高分子材料有其物理和化學極限，必須在這些限制範圍內運作。
blocks.en: Assessing the technical feasibility of SUS is like choosing kitchen equipment: you would not use a plastic pot for deep frying (temperature limit), nor a paper cup to store acidic juice for a long time (chemical compatibility). The polymeric materials in SUS have physical and chemical limits, and they must be operated within those limits.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 風險分析: TR66 明確要求技術可行性的判定過程必須記錄在符合 ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management，品質風險管理) 方法論的風險分析文件中。這不是可選的 — 而是一項合規要求。
blocks.en: ICH Q9 risk analysis: TR66 explicitly requires that the determination of technical feasibility be documented in a risk analysis that follows the ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management) methodology. This is not optional; it is a compliance requirement.

blocks.zh: 客製化的兩難: 使用供應商的標準配置較具成本效益，但有時必須客製化以符合組織需求。客製化意味著小量生產，這對供應商而言效率較低，成本也較高。此外，客製化產品的供應風險也更大。
blocks.en: The customization dilemma: Using the supplier's standard configuration is more cost-effective, but sometimes customization is needed to meet an organization's requirements. Customization means small production runs, which are less efficient and more costly for the supplier. In addition, the supply risk of customized products is higher.

blocks.zh: 列舉三種製程情境，在技術上可能不適合使用 SUS（提示：考慮溫度、壓力、體積）。
blocks.en: List three process scenarios in which SUS may not be technically suitable (hint: consider temperature, pressure, and volume).

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SUS 的 barrier properties 對生物製劑特別重要？光線和氧氣如何影響蛋白質藥物？
blocks.en: Why are the barrier properties of SUS especially important for biologics? How do light and oxygen affect protein drugs?

blocks.zh: 3.2 Business Drivers for the Adoption of Single-Use Systems 3.2 採用一次性使用系統之商業驅動因素
blocks.en: 3.2 Business Drivers for the Adoption of Single-Use Systems

blocks.zh: Business Drivers (商業驅動因素): SUS 導入決策不能僅憑技術可行性，還需要一個完整的商業分析模型。TR66 列出六大類商業考量：
blocks.en: Business Drivers: The decision to adopt SUS cannot rest on technical feasibility alone; a complete business analysis model is also needed. TR66 lists six categories of business considerations:

blocks.zh: Capital Design (資本設計): 一次性投資，包括設備、廠房、驗證等
blocks.en: Capital Design: One-time investment, including equipment, facility, validation, and so on

blocks.zh: Operating Costs (營運成本): 每日變動成本，如人力、能源、廢棄物
blocks.en: Operating Costs: Daily variable costs such as labor, energy, and waste

blocks.zh: Drug Development (藥物開發): 上市時程、製程複雜度、人力技能
blocks.en: Drug Development: Time to market, process complexity, and workforce skills

blocks.zh: Time (時間): 建置時間、法規里程碑、市場競爭時程
blocks.en: Time: Build time, regulatory milestones, and market competition timelines

blocks.zh: Green Manufacturing (綠色製造): 環境影響、廢棄物管理
blocks.en: Green Manufacturing: Environmental impact and waste management

blocks.zh: Value-Added Activities (增值活動): 品質成本、外包策略
blocks.en: Value-Added Activities: Cost of quality and outsourcing strategy

blocks.zh: Greenfield Facility (全新設施): 指從零開始建造的新廠房，與 Retrofit (改建現有設施) 相對。SUS 的一大優勢是大幅降低 greenfield 設施的資本投資需求。
blocks.en: Greenfield Facility: A new facility built from scratch, as opposed to a retrofit of an existing facility. One major advantage of SUS is that it greatly reduces the capital investment needed for a greenfield facility.

blocks.zh: SUS vs MUS 的商業分析就像買車的全生命週期成本 (TCO) 評估。你不能只看車價 (資本投入)，還要考慮油耗 (營運成本)、保養費 (維護)、保險 (風險管理)、停車位 (廠房空間)，甚至轉手價值 (設施未來用途)。每個組織的情況不同，就像每個人的通勤距離和用車習慣不同，最終的最佳選擇也會不同。
blocks.en: The business analysis of SUS vs MUS is like assessing the total cost of ownership (TCO) of buying a car. You cannot look only at the price (capital investment); you must also consider fuel consumption (operating costs), servicing (maintenance), insurance (risk management), parking space (facility footprint), and even resale value (future use of the facility). Every organization is different, just as every person has a different commute and driving habits, so the best choice will differ as well.

blocks.zh: 成本比較框架 Cost Comparison Framework
blocks.en: Cost Comparison Framework

blocks.zh:
SUS 總成本 = 較低的資本投入 + 較高的營運成本 (SUS耗材)
             + 較低的驗證成本 (無CIP/SIP)
             + 較低的換線成本 + 廢棄物處理成本

MUS 總成本 = 較高的資本投入 + 較低的營運耗材
             + 較高的驗證成本 (CIP/SIP/清潔確效)
             + 較高的換線成本 + 較高的用水/用電成本

判斷依據: 批次數量、產品數量、設施類型 (多產品/單產品)
blocks.en:
SUS total cost = lower capital investment + higher operating cost (SUS consumables)
             + lower validation cost (no CIP/SIP)
             + lower changeover cost + waste disposal cost

MUS total cost = higher capital investment + lower operating consumables
             + higher validation cost (CIP/SIP/cleaning validation)
             + higher changeover cost + higher water/electricity cost

Basis for the decision: number of batches, number of products, facility type (multi-product/single-product)

blocks.zh: 經濟分析的時機: TR66 特別強調，經濟分析應該在「一開始」就進行，作為高階製造策略開發的一部分。不要等到技術評估完成後才開始思考成本問題 — 二者應該並行。
blocks.en: Timing of the economic analysis: TR66 specifically stresses that the economic analysis should be carried out "at the outset" as part of developing the high-level manufacturing strategy. Do not wait until the technical assessment is complete before thinking about cost; the two should run in parallel.

blocks.zh: 無法給出通用建議: TR66 明確指出，由於每個組織的情況 (規模、時機、設施、產品需求、製程頻率) 都不同，不可能提供特定的模型設計建議。重點在於「必須做經濟分析」，而非告訴你哪個選項一定更好。
blocks.en: No universal recommendation: TR66 states clearly that because every organization's circumstances differ (size, timing, facility, product demand, process frequency), it is not possible to give specific recommendations on model design. The point is that an economic analysis "must be done", not to tell you which option is always better.

blocks.zh: CDMO 決策情境: 假設你的 CDMO 正在評估是否為一個新的 Phase III 生物製劑客戶建立產能：
blocks.en: CDMO decision scenario: Suppose your CDMO is evaluating whether to build capacity for a new Phase III biologic client:

blocks.zh: 如果選擇 MUS：需要 18-24 個月建置時間，但單批成本較低
blocks.en: If MUS is chosen: 18-24 months to build, but the cost per batch is lower

blocks.zh: 如果選擇 SUS：可在 6-9 個月內投產，但每批 SUS 耗材成本較高
blocks.en: If SUS is chosen: production can start within 6-9 months, but the SUS consumable cost per batch is higher

blocks.zh: 如果產品通過審查後需求激增，SUS 更容易快速擴充產能
blocks.en: If demand surges after the product is approved, SUS makes it easier to scale up capacity quickly

blocks.zh: 在這種情境下，time-to-market 和產品生命週期不確定性將是關鍵決策因素。
blocks.en: In this scenario, time to market and the uncertainty of the product life cycle will be the key decision factors.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR66 將 Green Manufacturing 列為商業驅動因素之一？SUS 在環境永續性方面的利弊為何？
blocks.en: Why does TR66 list Green Manufacturing as one of the business drivers? What are the pros and cons of SUS for environmental sustainability?

blocks.zh: 一家專注於細胞治療的小型 CDMO，其 SUS 商業分析中哪些因素會特別突出？
blocks.en: For a small CDMO focused on cell therapy, which factors would stand out in its SUS business analysis?

blocks.zh: 「Cost of quality and cost of failure」如何影響 SUS vs MUS 的決策？請舉例說明。
blocks.en: How do "cost of quality and cost of failure" affect the SUS vs MUS decision? Please give an example.

blocks.zh: 3.3 Qualification and Verification of Suppliers, Materials, Components, and Completed Assemblies 3.3 供應商、物料、組件及完成組裝件之確效與驗證
blocks.en: 3.3 Qualification and Verification of Suppliers, Materials, Components, and Completed Assemblies

blocks.zh: Extractables & Leachables, E&L (可萃取物與溶出物): 這是 SUS 最獨特的風險領域之一。
blocks.en: Extractables & Leachables, E&L: This is one of the most distinctive risk areas of SUS.

blocks.zh: Extractables (可萃取物): 在實驗室加速條件下，從 SUS 材料中萃取出的化學物質
blocks.en: Extractables: Chemical substances extracted from SUS materials under accelerated laboratory conditions

blocks.zh: Leachables (溶出物): 在實際製程條件下，從 SUS 材料遷移到製程流體中的化學物質
blocks.en: Leachables: Chemical substances that migrate from SUS materials into the process fluid under actual process conditions

blocks.zh: E&L 評估是一個兩步驟過程：先進行 extractables 研究以識別潛在風險物質，若發現疑慮物質，再進行進一步的 leachables 研究。
blocks.en: E&L assessment is a two-step process: an extractables study is performed first to identify potential risk substances, and if substances of concern are found, a further leachables study follows.

blocks.zh: Cross-contamination (交叉污染): SUS 一次性使用的特性實際上是一個優勢 — 它最小化了產品間的交叉污染風險，這在多產品設施中尤為重要。
blocks.en: Cross-contamination: The single-use nature of SUS is in fact an advantage; it minimizes the risk of cross-contamination between products, which is especially important in multi-product facilities.

blocks.zh: E&L 的概念就像用塑膠容器加熱食物。你知道塑膠在高溫下可能釋放化學物質到食物中。Extractables 就像在實驗室用極端條件測試「最壞情況下會釋放什麼」；Leachables 則是「正常使用時實際釋放了什麼」。對於藥品製造，這種評估至關重要，因為任何溶出物都可能影響藥物品質和病人安全。
blocks.en: The E&L concept is like heating food in a plastic container. You know plastic may release chemicals into the food at high temperature. Extractables are like testing under extreme conditions in the laboratory to see "what could be released in the worst case"; leachables are "what was actually released during normal use". For pharmaceutical manufacturing this assessment is critical, because any leachable could affect drug quality and patient safety.

blocks.zh: 「越靠近最終產品，風險越高」: TR66 反覆強調 SUS 與最終藥品的「接近度 (proximity)」概念。在上游製程（如培養基配製）中使用 SUS 的風險，遠低於在最終充填步驟中使用。這是因為下游製程的純化步驟可以移除許多潛在污染物。
blocks.en: "The closer to the final product, the higher the risk": TR66 repeatedly emphasizes the concept of the "proximity" of SUS to the final drug product. Using SUS in upstream processing (such as media preparation) carries far less risk than using it in the final filling step. This is because downstream purification steps can remove many potential contaminants.

blocks.zh: 微粒 (Particulates) 風險: SUS 在製造和操作過程中容易產生微粒，這是 SUS 特有的風險。因此需要適當的微粒監測和控制策略。
blocks.en: Particulates risk: SUS readily generate particulates during manufacture and operation, which is a risk specific to SUS. An appropriate particulate monitoring and control strategy is therefore needed.

blocks.zh: 備援策略: 必須考慮 SU 連接器故障時的備援方案，例如維持 ISO 5/Grade A-B 環境以進行無菌管路焊接。
blocks.en: Contingency strategy: A contingency plan must be considered for the failure of an SU connector, for example maintaining an ISO 5/Grade A-B environment for aseptic tube welding.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SUS 在減少交叉污染方面比 MUS 更有優勢？在什麼情況下這個優勢最為關鍵？
blocks.en: Why does SUS have an advantage over MUS in reducing cross-contamination? In what situations is this advantage most critical?

blocks.zh: MAB glycan profile 受溫度控制限制影響的例子，說明了 SUS 的什麼類型的風險？
blocks.en: The example of the MAB glycan profile being affected by limitations in temperature control illustrates what type of SUS risk?

blocks.zh: 你如何建立一個 SUS 連接器故障的備援計畫？需要哪些設施和人員準備？
blocks.en: How would you build a contingency plan for SUS connector failure? What facilities and personnel preparation are needed?

blocks.zh: 3.4 Process Control Strategy Considerations 3.4 製程管制策略考量
blocks.en: 3.4 Process Control Strategy Considerations

blocks.zh: SUS Interchangeability (SUS 互換性): 這是 TR66 的一個重要概念。如果你採用供應商的專有控制系統，雖然功能完整，但會被「鎖定」在該供應商的生態系統中。TR66 建議考慮使用跨平台的 SCADA 系統來保持彈性。
blocks.en: SUS Interchangeability: This is an important TR66 concept. If you adopt a supplier's proprietary control system, it is fully functional but you become "locked in" to that supplier's ecosystem. TR66 recommends considering a cross-platform SCADA system to preserve flexibility.

blocks.zh: Single-Use Probes (一次性探頭): SUS 中的感測器 (如 pH、溫度、溶氧探頭) 可能是預先整合在系統中的一次性探頭。這帶來校準的挑戰 — 如果探頭已經內建在預滅菌的系統中，傳統的使用前校準程序可能不適用。
blocks.en: Single-Use Probes: Sensors in an SUS (such as pH, temperature, and dissolved oxygen probes) may be single-use probes pre-integrated into the system. This creates a calibration challenge: if the probe is already built into a pre-sterilized system, the traditional pre-use calibration procedure may not be applicable.

blocks.zh: SUS 的自動化挑戰就像從全自動洗碗機切換到手洗。手洗 (SUS 較多手動操作) 需要更多的操作員技能和標準化訓練，而全自動 (MUS 的固定系統) 則依賴設備本身的一致性。選擇哪種方式取決於你的產量、人力素質和預算。
blocks.en: The automation challenge of SUS is like switching from a fully automatic dishwasher to washing by hand. Hand washing (SUS, with more manual operations) requires more operator skill and standardized training, whereas a fully automatic machine (the fixed systems of MUS) relies on the consistency of the equipment itself. Which approach to choose depends on your throughput, workforce quality, and budget.

blocks.zh: 操作員依賴度增加: SUS 通常包含更多的手動控制，這意味著對操作員訓練和執行能力的依賴度更高。這在 GMP 環境中是一個重要的考量 — 人為錯誤的風險可能增加。
blocks.en: Greater reliance on operators: SUS typically involve more manual control, which means greater dependence on operator training and execution. This is an important consideration in a GMP environment, because the risk of human error may increase.

blocks.zh: 批次策略改變: 由於 SUS 容器體積可能較小，可能需要調整批次策略，例如增加批次頻率、使用子批次 (sub-batch) 或批次合併 (batch pooling)。這會影響品質控制和放行策略。
blocks.en: Changes to batch strategy: Because SUS containers may be smaller in volume, the batch strategy may need to be adjusted, for example by increasing batch frequency, using sub-batches, or batch pooling. This affects quality control and release strategy.

blocks.zh: 如果你選擇了供應商的專有 SCADA 系統，在該供應商停止支援時會面臨什麼風險？如何透過 cross-platform SCADA 來降低此風險？
blocks.en: If you choose a supplier's proprietary SCADA system, what risks do you face when that supplier ends support? How can a cross-platform SCADA reduce this risk?

blocks.zh: 一次性 pH 探頭預先整合在預滅菌系統中，你如何確保其測量準確度？需要什麼替代的校準策略？
blocks.en: A single-use pH probe is pre-integrated into a pre-sterilized system. How do you ensure its measurement accuracy? What alternative calibration strategy is needed?

blocks.zh: 3.5 Implementation of a Single-Use System 3.5 一次性使用系統之實施
blocks.en: 3.5 Implementation of a Single-Use System

blocks.zh: Implementation (實施): TR66 將 SUS 實施分為九大主題，涵蓋從利害關係人管理到變更通知的完整範圍。這反映了 SUS 導入不僅是技術專案，更是組織變革專案。
blocks.en: Implementation: TR66 divides SUS implementation into nine topics, covering the full range from stakeholder management to change notification. This reflects that adopting SUS is not only a technical project but also an organizational change project.

blocks.zh: PVV - Process Validation and Verification (製程確效與驗證): SUS 的確效策略與 MUS 截然不同。傳統的 IQ/OQ/PQ 模式可能不完全適用，因為 SUS 的品質高度依賴供應商的製造品質和一致性。因此，供應商管理和品質協議變得至關重要。
blocks.en: PVV - Process Validation and Verification: The validation strategy for SUS is quite different from that for MUS. The traditional IQ/OQ/PQ model may not be fully applicable, because the quality of an SUS depends heavily on the supplier's manufacturing quality and consistency. Supplier management and quality agreements therefore become critically important.

blocks.zh: Regulatory Support File (法規支援檔案): 與 Drug Master File (DMF) 不同，法規支援檔案的資訊可直接提供給終端使用者。由於 DMF 的內容可能不夠詳盡（例如僅列出添加劑的最高允許量而非實際規格範圍），且終端使用者無法直接取得 DMF 資訊，因此 TR66 建議優先取得法規支援檔案形式的資訊。
blocks.en: Regulatory Support File: Unlike a Drug Master File (DMF), the information in a regulatory support file can be provided directly to the end user. Because the content of a DMF may not be detailed enough (for example, it may list only the maximum permitted amount of an additive rather than the actual specification range), and because end users cannot access the DMF directly, TR66 recommends obtaining the information in the form of a regulatory support file first.

blocks.zh: SUS 的供應鏈管理就像經營一家完全依賴外送食材的餐廳。不同於傳統餐廳可以自己種菜養魚 (MUS 自有設備)，你的每一道菜都依賴外部供應商。這意味著你必須：(1) 確認供應商的品質一致 (供應商確認)，(2) 備有第二供應商以防斷貨 (secondary sources)，(3) 確保食材在運送過程中不變質 (運輸完整性)，(4) 管理好倉儲和庫存 (inventory management)，(5) 供應商換食譜時要提前通知你 (change notification)。
blocks.en: SUS supply chain management is like running a restaurant that depends entirely on delivered ingredients. Unlike a traditional restaurant that can grow its own vegetables and raise its own fish (MUS, with its own equipment), every dish you make depends on outside suppliers. This means you must: (1) confirm consistent supplier quality (supplier qualification), (2) have a second supplier in case of stock-outs (secondary sources), (3) make sure ingredients do not spoil in transit (transport integrity), (4) manage storage and stock well (inventory management), and (5) be notified in advance when a supplier changes a recipe (change notification).

blocks.zh: Stakeholder Management (利害關係人管理): SUS 導入可能在組織內造成壓力和抗拒。想像一下：維護團隊可能擔心工作減少、QA 團隊需要學習新的確效方法、倉儲團隊面臨更大的空間壓力。有效的利害關係人管理是成功的關鍵。
blocks.en: Stakeholder Management: SUS adoption may cause pressure and resistance within the organization. Imagine this: the maintenance team may worry about having less work, the QA team needs to learn new validation approaches, and the warehouse team faces greater space pressure. Effective stakeholder management is the key to success.

blocks.zh: Single Supplier Risk (單一供應商風險): 這是 SUS 最大的戰略風險之一。如果某個關鍵組件（如特殊薄膜或專利連接器）只有一家供應商，而該供應商因故無法供貨，整條生產線可能停擺。TR66 要求這類風險必須記錄在風險評估文件中，並透過合約條款來保護（特別是涉及 IP 保護的情況）。
blocks.en: Single Supplier Risk: This is one of the biggest strategic risks of SUS. If a critical component (such as a special film or a proprietary connector) has only one supplier, and that supplier cannot deliver for some reason, the entire production line may come to a halt. TR66 requires that such risks be recorded in the risk assessment documentation and protected through contract terms (especially where IP protection is involved).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 - 物流控制 Key Notes - Logistics
blocks.en: Key Notes - Logistics

blocks.zh: 廢棄物挑戰: SUS 產生的固體廢棄物顯著多於 MUS。廢棄物管理不僅是環保議題，也涉及交叉污染風險（含有活性藥物成分或生物材料的廢棄 SUS 需要妥善去活化處理）。
blocks.en: The waste challenge: SUS generate significantly more solid waste than MUS. Waste management is not only an environmental issue but also involves cross-contamination risk (used SUS containing active pharmaceutical ingredients or biological material must be properly inactivated).

blocks.zh: 倉儲需求: SUS 對倉儲的要求遠高於 MUS。大量的一次性組件需要適當的儲存空間和環境控制。SUS 通常在使用時才完全拆封，因此進貨檢驗主要限於包裝和標籤的確認。
blocks.en: Storage needs: SUS demand far more storage than MUS. Large quantities of single-use components need appropriate storage space and environmental control. SUS are usually unpacked fully only at the time of use, so incoming inspection is mainly limited to checking the packaging and labeling.

blocks.zh: Change Notification (變更通知): 終端使用者必須與所有供應商（包括第三方供應商）建立變更通知協議。這些協議必須提供足夠的時間來評估變更對 SUS 功能性的影響。這是維持 SUS 運作可預測性和穩定性的基礎。
blocks.en: Change Notification: End users must establish change notification agreements with all suppliers (including third-party suppliers). These agreements must allow enough time to assess the impact of a change on SUS functionality. This is the foundation for keeping SUS operations predictable and stable.

blocks.zh: 供應鏈風險管理情境: 2020 年 COVID-19 疫情期間，全球 SUS 供應鏈嚴重緊縮，許多藥廠面臨 SUS 耗材短缺。這個真實案例完美印證了 TR66 關於 secondary sources 和 inventory management 的建議。
blocks.en: Supply chain risk management scenario: During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, the global SUS supply chain tightened severely, and many pharmaceutical manufacturers faced shortages of SUS consumables. This real case illustrates TR66's recommendations on secondary sources and inventory management.

blocks.zh: CDMO 最佳實踐:
blocks.en: CDMO best practices:

blocks.zh: 為關鍵 SUS 組件維持至少 3-6 個月的安全庫存
blocks.en: Maintain safety stock of at least 3-6 months for critical SUS components

blocks.zh: 為關鍵組件確認至少一個替代供應商
blocks.en: Identify at least one alternative supplier for critical components

blocks.zh: 在供應合約中納入 12-18 個月的變更通知期
blocks.en: Include a 12-18 month change notification period in supply contracts

blocks.zh: 定期（至少每年一次）審核關鍵供應商的品質系統和產能
blocks.en: Audit the quality system and capacity of critical suppliers regularly (at least once a year)

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR66 說傳統的確效活動 (qualification activities) 對 SUS 的價值有限？SUS 的確效策略應該更加關注哪些面向？
blocks.en: Why does TR66 say that traditional qualification activities have limited value for SUS? What aspects should the SUS validation strategy focus on more?

blocks.zh: 如果你是一家 CDMO 的供應鏈經理，你如何建立一個「SUS 供應鏈風險矩陣」？哪些組件應該被歸類為最高風險？
blocks.en: If you were the supply chain manager of a CDMO, how would you build an "SUS supply chain risk matrix"? Which components should be classified as highest risk?

blocks.zh: Change notification agreement 應該包含哪些關鍵要素？提前通知期應該設定為多長？為什麼？
blocks.en: What key elements should a change notification agreement contain? How long should the advance notice period be, and why?

blocks.zh: 比較 SUS 和 MUS 在廢棄物管理方面的差異。SUS 廢棄物中哪些成分需要特別的去活化處理？
blocks.en: Compare SUS and MUS in terms of waste management. Which components of SUS waste need special inactivation treatment?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 四大決策領域: SUS 製造策略必須全面考量技術 (Technology)、確認 (Qualification)、商業驅動 (Business Drivers) 和實施 (Implementation) 四大領域，缺一不可
blocks.en: Four decision areas: An SUS manufacturing strategy must comprehensively consider all four areas: Technology, Qualification, Business Drivers, and Implementation; none can be omitted

blocks.zh: 閘門式決策: 採用 Gated Approach，在技術可行性、商業可行性、產品風險、製程風險、製程控制策略和物流控制等六個閘門逐一評估，任何一個閘門未通過即應停止導入
blocks.en: Gated decision: Using the Gated Approach, assess each of the six gates in turn (technical feasibility, business case, product risk, process risk, process control strategy, and logistics control); failure at any one gate means adoption should be stopped

blocks.zh: Fail Fast 原則: 閘門式決策的核心目標是在發現無法解決的重大問題時，能夠快速中止導入過程，避免浪費資源
blocks.en: Fail Fast principle: The core goal of the gated decision is to be able to stop the adoption process quickly when a significant problem that cannot be resolved is found, avoiding wasted resources

blocks.zh: E&L 評估: SUS 材料與製程流體的交互作用（特別是 Extractables & Leachables）是最關鍵的產品風險考量，與最終藥品的接近程度直接影響風險等級
blocks.en: E&L assessment: The interaction between SUS materials and the process fluid (especially Extractables & Leachables) is the most critical product risk consideration, and proximity to the final drug product directly affects the risk level

blocks.zh: 供應鏈依賴性: SUS 比 MUS 更加依賴供應商，因此供應商管理、第二供應商確認、庫存管理和變更通知協議是確保供應穩定的關鍵要素
blocks.en: Supply chain dependency: SUS depend on suppliers more than MUS do, so supplier management, qualification of a second supplier, inventory management, and change notification agreements are the key elements for ensuring a stable supply

blocks.zh: 經濟分析: 必須在策略開發初期就進行 SUS vs MUS 的經濟分析，考量資本設計、營運成本、藥物開發時程、綠色製造和增值活動等多維度因素
blocks.en: Economic analysis: The SUS vs MUS economic analysis must be carried out at the very beginning of strategy development, considering multiple dimensions such as capital design, operating costs, drug development timeline, green manufacturing, and value-added activities

blocks.zh: 組織變革: SUS 導入不僅是技術專案，更是組織變革，需要有效的利害關係人管理來應對可能的組織壓力和抗拒
blocks.en: Organizational change: SUS adoption is not only a technical project but also an organizational change, and it requires effective stakeholder management to address possible organizational pressure and resistance
